detail.longDescription: Lots of radio updates on https://system64.computer/radio/ system64 radio has a phone number now! text a song to 943-8-TUNEIN (+1 943 888 6346) and it plays automatically what you text. ...but if you call and leave a message, it goes out on the air. anonymous of course. also new: shows. late night shoegaze on fridays, slow sunday mornings, a few others. the schedule's on the page. and if you hear a 2600hz tone (iykyk), start recording. Maybe you can take over the whole thing. https://system64.computer/radio/ #internetradio #selfhosted #indieweb #shoegaze #phreaking #music #radio
